title: Contractor 'MS' finds a craft being disassembled at Dugway's Avery section
summary: UAPGerb tells of Contractor 'MS' finds a craft being disassembled at Dugway's Avery section, about unspecified at Avery section, Dugway Proving Ground, Utah, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Avery section, Dugway Proving Ground, Utah

tellings.quote: he's doing electrical meter reading, and he goes inside a facility, and within that facility, which is out in the middle of nowhere on Avery, there's a a craft in a very in what's seemingly going in a state of disassembling.

plain: A researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb tells a story he heard from a contractor he calls only "MS", who was reading electric meters at Dugway Proving Ground, a US Army testing range in the Utah desert. According to UAPGerb, MS walked into a building in a remote part of the base called Avery and saw a craft that seemed to be in the middle of being taken apart. If true, it would point to unusual craft being studied in secret on military land.
